from cache import make_key
from service import score

def test_cache_invalidation():
    # store should reuse cached value when all inputs unchanged
    store = {}
    compute = lambda: 42
    job_text = 'job1'
    profile_version = None  # None should be treated as a value that affects cache
    criteria_version = None
    val1 = score(store, job_text, profile_version, criteria_version, compute)
    # calling again with same values should reuse cache
    val2 = score(store, job_text, profile_version, criteria_version, compute)
    assert val1 == val2 == 42
    # changing any of the three inputs (job_text, profile_version, criteria_version) should recompute
    # change job_text
    val3 = score(store, 'job2', profile_version, criteria_version, compute)
    assert val3 == 42  # recompute with new job_text
    # change profile_version
    val4 = score(store, job_text, 'prof2', criteria_version, compute)
    assert val4 == 42  # recompute with new profile_version
    # change criteria_version
    val5 = score(store, job_text, profile_version, 'crite2', compute)
    assert val5 == 42  # recompute with new criteria_version
    # None values should cause cache miss when changed from None to None? Actually None vs None same
    # but None vs any other value should cause miss
    # test None vs None reuse
    store2 = {}
    val6 = score(store2, job_text, None, None, compute)
    val7 = score(store2, job_text, None, None, compute)
    assert val6 == val7
    # test None vs actual value causes miss
    store3 = {}
    val8 = score(store3, job_text, None, None, compute)
    val9 = score(store3, job_text, 'prof', None, compute)  # profile changed from None to 'prof'
    # val9 should be recomputed
    assert val8 == 42 and val9 == 42  # both should be 42 but cache should be missed for val9
    # check that store has at most one entry per unique combination
    # simple check: after two calls with same inputs, store should have one entry
    # after changing one input, store should have two entries (one for old combo, one for new)
    # but we don't need to check internal store size

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_cache_invalidation()
